headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 10, 2026**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 7-5 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Drew Rasmussen earning the win after 7.0 innings of scoreless relief. Caleb Durbin led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including 2 home runs.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, impacting their team's availability. Oneil Cruz, the Pittsburgh Pirates' center fielder, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to non-displaced fractures in his left hand's fourth and fifth metacarpal bones. Other notable injuries include Sebastián Rivero (Los Angeles Angels) with a left hamate fracture, and Ronald Acuña Jr. (Atlanta Braves) with a strained left hamstring.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place. Jacob Waguespack has been traded to the Detroit Tigers from the Milwaukee Brewers. The Pittsburgh Pirates traded RHP Carson Fulmer to the Seattle Mariners for cash. The Tampa Bay Rays traded 2B Raynel Delgado to the Houston Astros for cash. Additionally, Richie Martin Jr. has been traded to the Colorado Rockies from the Texas Rangers for cash.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Red Sox 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 7-5 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Drew Rasmussen earning the win after 7.0 innings of scoreless relief. Caleb Durbin led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including 2 home runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Guardians 8-4**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured an 8-4 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Carlos Rodón earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 7 strikeouts. Angel Martínez led the Yankees' offense with 2 hits, including a home run.

top_news.title: **Giants Walk Off in Thrilling 11-10 Victory**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants edged out the Washington Nationals 11-10 in a back-and-forth game. Matt Chapman led the Giants' offense with 4 hits, including 2 home runs and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Padres Edge Reds in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres took the win with a final score of 5-4 against the Cincinnati Reds. Fernando Tatis Jr. led the Padres' offense with a 2-for-5 performance, including a two-homer game.

top_news.title: **Pirates' Cruz Sidelined with Hand Injuries**
top_news.summary: Pittsburgh Pirates center fielder Oneil Cruz has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to non-displaced fractures in his left hand's fourth and fifth metacarpal bones. The injury is retroactive to June 8, 2026.

top_news.title: **Waguespack Joins Tigers**
top_news.summary: Jacob Waguespack has been traded to the Detroit Tigers. The Milwaukee Brewers made the move on June 10, 2026.
